faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support-III recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the AIIMS Delhi Project Technical Support-III recruitment is 15th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate Degree (M.Sc./M.A. or equivalent) in specific professional courses like Cognitive Sciences, Psychology, Bioinformatics, or a B.Tech in Computer Sciences, Data Science, or Electronics. UGC NET-JRF qualification is desired.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address provided in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the Project Technical Support-III position?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves shortlisting of applications followed by an interview of the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Project Technical Support-III at AIIMS Delhi is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q7. Where is AIIMS Delhi located?
faq.answer: AIIMS Delhi is located in New Delhi, with the pincode 110029.

faq.question: Q8. Are there any age relaxations provided?
faq.answer: Specific age limit details and relaxation criteria are not provided in the summary. Candidates are advised to check the official notification for this information.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I attach with my application?
faq.answer: You should attach self-attested copies of all required documents, including educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply offline?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is strictly via email. Offline applications will not be accepted.
